articles.title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
articles.snippet: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

articles.title: Ethereum wallets holding $72 billion ETH are under threat of a future quantum attack
articles.snippet: Researchers find that accounts with visible public keys hold nearly 55% of ether outside staking, and propose a way to move them to quantum-resistant security.

articles.title: South Korea to expand cryptocurrency account freezes and curb illicit transfers abroad
articles.snippet: The proposed measures would also expand a June phishing-account suspension system, which has already frozen more than 11,500 accounts, to cover other serious financial crimes.

articles.title: Cardano holders are turning down a $4 million request for running its flagship event
articles.snippet: Roughly five times as much voting stake has opposed the Foundation's 2027 conference budget as has backed it, while a developer tools request filed on Nov. 16 faces almost no opposition.

articles.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
articles.snippet: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.
